duplicate_sleeper_gsis_id_policy: Any GSIS ID represented by more than one raw Sleeper player record is ambiguous and cannot produce a candidate, even if later filtering would leave one match.

requirements: the exact GSIS rule is independently eligible under at least 500 known-pair comparisons with zero conflicts
the old stable GSIS claimant is outside the frozen B42 current-eligible population
the unique Sleeper candidate directly exposes the current GSIS ID
the Sleeper candidate matches the frozen current player's canonical name and compatible position family
the frozen B41I current identity and the Sleeper candidate both have nonmissing birth dates and those birth dates are exactly equal
no second current-eligible GSIS row claims the same Sleeper ID

matching_rule: GSIS_ID_EXACT: frozen current GSIS ID must equal Sleeper object's nonmissing gsis_id exactly; that GSIS ID must occur on exactly one raw Sleeper player record before filtering; the candidate must also match canonical name and compatible position family, and a conflicting nonmissing birth date vetoes the match
motivation: B43 V3R2 reached a valid scientific STOP because exact ESPN IDs produced only 382 known-pair trials and zero target-population supplements. B43 V4R2 prospectively re-specifies the B43 objective before any V4R1/V4R2 identity result: population-wide coverage is descriptive only, while the exact direct-Sleeper-GSIS precision safeguards remain hard gates and B44 retains the unchanged rostered acceptance gates.

objective_respecification.rationale: The 99.5% population coverage screen was an underived proxy for B44. B44's unchanged rostered per-team gates (>=98% per team, <=2pp range) are the actual acceptance test.

owner_objective: Players on fantasy rosters must be correctly identified and receive roles; deep depth players matching is not a product requirement.
position_compatibility: QB exact; RB/HB/FB -> RB; WR exact; TE exact; K/PK -> K; DL/DE/DT/NT/ED/EDGE/LB/ILB/OLB -> FRONT7; DB/CB/S/FS/SS -> DB

sources.candidate_sleeper_identity_source: newly frozen https://api.sleeper.app/v1/players/nfl bytes; Sleeper object's gsis_id is the direct current identifier
sources.current_identity_truth: exact frozen B41I nflverse players.csv snapshot for canonical name, position family, and DOB contradiction safeguards
sources.current_population: exact frozen B42 V4 owner-blind role-eligibility artifact
sources.reference_pairs: B41G-pinned DynastyProcess GSIS<->Sleeper crosswalk, used only as known-pair validation truth and historical inverse evidence
